paragraphs.sourceText: France's beloved cathedral only minutes away from complete destruction
paragraphs.translationZh: 法国心爱的大教堂距离彻底毁坏仅几分钟路程

paragraphs.sourceText: A) Notre Dame Cathedral in the heart of Paris was within "15 to 30 minutes" of complete destruction as firefighters battled to stop flames reaching its bell towers on Monday evening, French authorities have revealed. A greater disaster was averted by members of the Paris fire brigade, who risked their lives to remain inside the burning monument to create a wall of water between the raging fire and the two towers on the west of the building.
paragraphs.translationZh: A) 法国当局透露，周一晚上，消防队员奋力阻止火焰蔓延至钟楼，巴黎市中心的巴黎圣母院在“15到30分钟”内就被完全摧毁。巴黎消防队的成员冒着生命危险留在燃烧的纪念碑内，在熊熊大火和建筑物西侧的两座塔楼之间筑起一道水墙，避免了一场更大的灾难。

paragraphs.sourceText: B) The revelation of how close. France came to losing its most famous cathedral emerged as pQlice investigators questioned workers involved in the restoration of the monument to try to estfl.blish the 6:20 pm on Monday evening but no fire was found. The second alert was sounded at 6:43 pm, and the blaze was discovered on the roof.

C) More than € 650 million was raised in a few hours on Tuesday as French business leaders and global corporations announced they would donate to a restoration campaign launched by the president, Emmanuel Macron. But as the. emergency services picked through the burnt debris, a row was resurfacing over accusations that the beloved cathedral, immortalised in Victor Hugo's novel, was already crumbling before the fire.
paragraphs.translationZh: C) 周二，法国商界领袖和跨国公司宣布，他们将向总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 发起的恢复运动捐款，数小时内筹集了超过 6.5 亿欧元。但作为.紧急服务人员在烧毁的废墟中搜寻，一场争吵再次浮出水面，指责维克多·雨果小说中不朽的受人爱戴的大教堂已经在大火中摇摇欲坠。

paragraphs.sourceText: D) The cathedral is owned by the French state and has been at the centre of a years-long dispute over who should finance restoration work of the collapsing staircases, crumbling statues and cracked walls. Jean­Michel Leniaud, the president of the scientific council at the N_a tional Heritage Institute, said: "What happened was bound to happen . .The lack of adequate maintenance and daily attention to such a majestic building is the cause of this catastrophe." After the blaze was declared completely extinguished, 15 hours after it started, the junior interior minister, Laurent Nunez, said the structure had been saved but remained vulnerable. He praised the actions of the firefighters but admitted the fate of the cathedral had been uncertain. "They saved the main structure, but it all came down to 15- 30 minutes," Nunez said.
paragraphs.translationZh: D) 大教堂归法国政府所有，多年来一直处于争论的中心，争论的焦点是谁应该资助倒塌的楼梯、摇摇欲坠的雕像和破裂的墙壁的修复工作。 N_国家遗产研究所科学委员会主席让·米歇尔·勒尼奥德 (JeanMichel Leniaud) 表示：“所发生的事情注定会发生……如此雄伟的建筑缺乏足够的维护和日常关注，是这场灾难的原因。”火灾发生 15 小时后，大火被宣布完全扑灭，内政部副部长洛朗·努涅斯 (Laurent Nunez) 表示，该建筑已获救，但仍很脆弱。他赞扬了消防员的行动，但承认大教堂的命运还不确定。 “他们保住了主体结构，但这一切都缩短到了 15 到 30 分钟，”努涅斯说。

paragraphs.sourceText: E) In a surprise televised address on Tuesday evening, Macron said he wanted to see the cathedral rebuilt within five years. "The fire at Notre Dame reminds us that we will always have challenges to overcome," Macron said, "Notre Dame is our history, our literature, the centre of our life. It is the standard by which we measure our distances. It's so many books, so many paintings. It's the cathedral of every French person, even those who have never visited it. This history is ours and so we will rebuild Notre Dame. It is what the French people expect; it is what our history deserves. It is our deep destiny. We will rebuild Notre Dame so it is even more beautiful than before. I want it done in the next five years. We can do it. After the time of testing comes a time of reflection and then of action."
paragraphs.translationZh: E) 在周二晚上的一次令人惊讶的电视讲话中，马克龙表示他希望看到大教堂在五年内重建。马克龙说：“巴黎圣母院的火灾提醒我们，我们永远都有需要克服的挑战。巴黎圣母院是我们的历史、我们的文学、我们生活的中心。它是我们衡量距离的标准。它有这么多的书籍、这么多的画作。它是每个法国人的大教堂，甚至是那些从未参观过它的人。这段历史是我们的，所以我们将重建巴黎圣母院。这是法国人民的期望，也是我们的历史。”这是我们应得的，我们将重建巴黎圣母院，让它比以前更加美丽。在经历了考验之后，我们将采取行动。”

paragraphs.sourceText: F) The fire, which had started at the base of the 93-metre spire ���� at about 6: 40 pm on Monday, spread through the cathedral's roof, made up of hundreds of oak beams, some dating back to the 13th century. These beams, known as la foret (the forest) because of their density, formed the cross­ shaped roof that ran the length of the central part of the cathedral. As hundreds of tourists and Parisians stood and watched the flames leaping from the roof, there was shock and tears as the cathedral spire caught fire, burned and then collapsed into itself.

G) A collection of dramatic videos and photos quickly spread across social media, showing the horrifying destruction, and attracting emotional responses from people all over the world. Indeed, within minutes the fire occupied headlines of every major global newspaper and television network. This is not surprising given Notre Dame Cathedral, meaning "Our Lady", is one of the most recognised symbols of the city of Paris attracting millions of tourists every year.
paragraphs.translationZh: G) 一组戏剧性的视频和照片迅速在社交媒体上传播，展示了可怕的破坏，并吸引了世界各地人们的情感反应。事实上，几分钟之内，这场火灾就占据了全球各大报纸和电视网络的头条新闻。这并不奇怪，因为巴黎圣母院（意为“圣母”）是巴黎市最知名的标志之一，每年吸引数百万游客。

paragraphs.sourceText: H) While the world looked on, the 500 firefighters at the scene then battled to prevent the flames from reaching the two main towers, where the cathedral bells hang. If the wooden frame of the towers had caught fire, it could have sent the bells-the largest of which, the Emmanuel Bell, weighs 13 tons­ crashing down, potentially causing the collapse of both towers. Police and fire services will spend the next 48 hours assessing the "security and safety" of the 850-year-old ·structure. Nunez said: "We have identified vulnerabilities throughout the structure, all of which still need securing." As a result, residents of five buildings around the northern side of the cathedral were being temporarily evacuated, he added. Architects have identified three main holes in the structure, in the locations of the spire, the main hall and the upper rooms to the north of the central aisle. Most of the wooden roof beams have been burned, and parts of the concrete holding up the roof have collapsed.
paragraphs.translationZh: H) 当全世界都在注视着的时候，现场的 500 名消防员奋力阻止火焰蔓延到挂有大教堂钟声的两座主塔楼。如果塔楼的木框架着火，可能会导致钟楼坠落，其中最大的钟重达 13 吨，可能会导致两座塔楼倒塌。警察和消防部门将在接下来的 48 小时内评估这座拥有 850 年历史的建筑的“安保和安全”。努涅斯说：“我们已经发现了整个结构的漏洞，所有这些漏洞仍然需要保护。”他补充说，因此，大教堂北侧周围五栋建筑的居民被暂时疏散。建筑师在结构中确定了三个主要洞口，分别位于尖顶、主厅和中央过道以北的上层房间。大部分木屋顶梁已被烧毁，支撑屋顶的部分混凝土也已倒塌。

paragraphs.sourceText: I) The interior minister, Christophe Castaner, visited the cathedral on Tuesday afternoon to see the extent of the devastation. Ash covered the marble diamond-patterned floor and floated in large pools of grey water from the fire hoses. Behind a heap of blackened oak beams that lay piled up where they had fallen, daylight from vast holes in the cathedral roof lit a golden cross over a statue by Nicolas Coustou, which appeared to have escaped- damage. Preliminary inspections also suggested -the three ornate ��������������� stained glass "rose" windows appeared to have survived the fire, officials said. However, fire officers have said a complete inventory of the damage will not be possible until the cathedral structure has been deemed safe.

J) The culture minister, Franck Riester, said religious relics saved from the cathedral were being securely held at the Hotel de Ville, and works of art that sustained smoke damage were being taken to the Louvre, the world's largest art museum, where they would be dried out, repaired and stored. Sixteen copper statues that decorated the spire had been removed for restoration only a few days before the fire. Relics at the top of the spire are believed lost as the spire was destroyed. As well as damage from the heat, which firefighters said reached more than 800 ·c , experts also need to assess damage from the vast quantities of water firefighters poured into the cathedral. One casualty of this was The Great Organ constructed in the 1730s, which was said to have escaped the flames but been significantly damaged by water.
paragraphs.translationZh: J) 文化部长弗兰克·里斯特表示，从大教堂保存下来的宗教文物正被安全地保存在巴黎市政厅，遭受烟雾损坏的艺术品正被送往世界上最大的艺术博物馆卢浮宫，在那里进行干燥、修复和储存。就在火灾发生前几天，装饰尖塔的十六尊铜雕像被拆除进行修复。据信，尖塔顶部的文物随着尖塔被毁而丢失。除了消防员所说的超过 800 摄氏度的高温造成的损害外，专家还需要评估消防员向大教堂注入大量水造成的损害。建于 1730 年代的大管风琴就是其中之一，据说它逃过了大火，但被水严重损坏。

paragraphs.sourceText: K) French political commentators noted the devastating fire had succeeded where Macron had failed in uniting the country. But criticism over the original state of the building is likely to intensify over coming days. Leniaud told La Croix newspaper: "This is not about looking for people to blame. The responsibility is collective because this is the most loved monument in the country." Alexandre Gady, an art historian, agreed. "We've been saying for years that the budget for maintaining historic monuments is too low," Gady said. The Paris prosecutor's office has opened an inquiry into "involuntary destruction by fire", indicating they believe the cause of the blaze was accidental rather than criminal.
paragraphs.translationZh: K) 法国政治评论员指出，马克龙未能团结国家，但毁灭性的火灾却成功了。但未来几天，对这座建筑原始状态的批评可能会加剧。勒尼奥告诉《La Croix》报纸：“这并不是要找人来指责。责任是集体的，因为这是这个国家最受欢迎的纪念碑。”艺术史学家亚历山大·加迪（Alexandre Gady）对此表示同意。 “多年来我们一直在说维护历史古迹的预算太低，”加迪说。巴黎检察官办公室已对“非自愿火灾破坏”展开调查，表明他们认为火灾的原因是意外而非犯罪。

paragraphs.sourceText: 36. The total amount of damage to Notre Dame Cathedral can be assessed only when its structure is considered safe.
paragraphs.translationZh: 36. 只有在其结构被认为是安全的情况下，才能评估巴黎圣母院的总损坏程度。

paragraphs.sourceText: 37. Once again people began to argue whether Notre Dame Cathedral was going to collapse even without the fire.
paragraphs.translationZh: 37. 人们再次开始争论即使没有火灾，巴黎圣母院是否也会倒塌。

paragraphs.sourceText: 38. The Notre Dame Cathedral catastrophe was said to have helped unite the French nation.
paragraphs.translationZh: 38. 据说巴黎圣母院的灾难有助于法国民族的团结。

paragraphs.sourceText: 39. The roof of Notre Dame Cathedral was built with large numbers of densely laid-out wood beams.
paragraphs.translationZh: 39. 巴黎圣母院的屋顶是用大量密集排列的木梁建造的。

paragraphs.sourceText: 40. Renovation workers of Notre Dame Cathedral were questioned to find out the cause of the accident.
paragraphs.translationZh: 40. 巴黎圣母院修缮工人接受询问，以查明事故原因。

paragraphs.sourceText: 41. Had the bell towers' wooden frames burned down, the heavy bells would have crashed down.
paragraphs.translationZh: 41. 如果钟楼的木架被烧毁，沉重的钟就会轰然倒塌。

paragraphs.sourceText: 42. The timely action of the firefighters prevented the fire from reaching the Cathedral's bell towers.
paragraphs.translationZh: 42. 消防员的及时行动阻止了火势蔓延到大教堂的钟楼。

paragraphs.sourceText: 43. Apart from the fire, the water used to extinguish it also caused a lot of damage to Notre Dame Cathedral.
paragraphs.translationZh: 43. 除了火灾之外，用于扑灭火灾的水也对巴黎圣母院造成了很大的损坏。

paragraphs.sourceText: 44. There has been argument over the years as to who should pay for the restoration of Notre Dame Cathedral.
paragraphs.translationZh: 44. 多年来，关于谁应该为巴黎圣母院的修复付费的问题一直存在争议。

paragraphs.sourceText: 45. News of the Notre Dame Cathedral catastrophe instantly caught media attention throughout the world.
paragraphs.translationZh: 45. 巴黎圣母院灾难的消息立即引起了全世界媒体的关注。

paragraphs.sourceText: Some researchers argue that doodling (涂画) activates the brain's so-called default circuit-essentially, the areas of the brain responsible for maintaining a baseline level of activity in the absence of other stimuli. Because of this, some believe that doodling during a boring lecture can help students pay attention. In one study, participants were asked to listen to a list of names while either doodling or sitting still. Those who doodled remembered 29 percent more of the names than those who did not. There's also evidence that drawing talent is based on how accurately someone perceives the world. The human visual system tends to misjudge size, shape, color, and angles but artists perceive these
paragraphs.translationZh: 一些研究人员认为，涂鸦会激活大脑所谓的默认回路，即在没有其他刺激的情况下负责维持基线活动水平的大脑区域。正因为如此，一些人认为在无聊的讲座中涂鸦可以帮助学生集中注意力。在一项研究中，参与者被要求一边涂鸦或坐着不动，一边听一系列名字。那些涂鸦的人比那些不涂鸦的人记住的名字多 29%。还有证据表明，吸引人才取决于一个人感知世界的准确程度。人类视觉系统往往会误判尺寸、形状、颜色和角度，但艺术家却能感知到这些

paragraphs.sourceText: qualities more accurately than non-artists. Cultivating drawing talent can become an essential tool to improve people's observational skills in fields where the visual is important.
paragraphs.translationZh: 比非艺术家更准确的品质。培养绘画天赋可以成为提高人们在视觉重要领域的观察能力的重要工具。

paragraphs.sourceText: Rather than ·think of drawing as a talent that some creative people are gifted in, we should consider it as a tool for seeing and understanding the world better-one that just so happens to double as an art form. Both absent-minded doodling and copying from life have been shown to positively affect your memory and visual perception, so complain loudly the next time your school board slashes the art department's budget.
paragraphs.translationZh: 我们不应该将绘画视为某些有创造力的人所具有的天赋，而应该将其视为更好地观察和理解世界的工具——它恰好也是一种艺术形式。事实证明，心不在焉的涂鸦和临摹生活都会对你的记忆力和视觉感知产生积极影响，所以下次当你的学校董事会削减艺术系的预算时，大声抱怨吧。

paragraphs.sourceText: 46. What do people generally think about drawing?
paragraphs.translationZh: 46. 人们通常如何看待绘画？

paragraphs.sourceText: 47. What do we learn about designers and artists?
paragraphs.translationZh: 47. 关于设计师和艺术家，我们了解什么？

paragraphs.sourceText: 48. What does Professor D. B. Dowd argue in his book?
paragraphs.translationZh: 48. D. B. Dowd 教授在他的书中主张什么？

paragraphs.sourceText: 49. What have some researchers found from one study about doodling?
paragraphs.translationZh: 49. 一些研究人员从一项关于涂鸦的研究中发现了什么？

paragraphs.sourceText: The car has reshaped our cities. It seems to offer autonomy for everyone. There is something almost delightful in the detachment from reality of advertisements showing mass-produced cars marketed as symbols of individuality and of freedom when most of their lives will be spent making short journeys on choked roads.
paragraphs.translationZh: 汽车重塑了我们的城市。它似乎为每个人提供了自主权。广告中将大量生产的汽车标榜为个性和自由的象征，而他们一生中的大部分时间都在拥挤的道路上进行短途旅行，广告中的这种脱离现实的感觉几乎是令人愉快的。

paragraphs.sourceText: For all the fuss made about top speeds, cornering ability and acceleration, the most useful gadgets on a modern car are those which work when you're going very slowly: parking sensors, sound systems, and navigation apps which will show a way around upcoming traffic jams. paragraphs.translationZh: 尽管人们对最高速度、转弯能力和加速度大惊小怪，但现代汽车上最有用的小工具是那些在你行驶速度非常慢时起作用的小工具：停车传感器、音响系统和导航应用程序，它们将在即将到来的交通拥堵时显示出一条路。这似乎是共享个人信息的好处直接返回给共享者的少数几个领域之一：因为这些应用程序知道几乎所有用户在哪里，以及他们几乎一直移动的速度有多快，所以他们可以发现

paragraphs.sourceText: The problem comes when everyone is using a navigation app which tells them to avoid everyone else using the same gadget. Traffic jams often appear where no one has enough information to avoid them. When a lucky few have access to the knowledge, they will benefit greatly. But when everyone has perfect information, traffic jams simply spread onto the side roads that seem to offer a way round them.
paragraphs.translationZh: 当每个人都使用导航应用程序时，问题就出现了，该应用程序告诉他们避免其他人使用相同的小工具。交通堵塞经常出现在没有人有足够信息来避免的情况下。当少数幸运者能够获得这些知识时，他们将受益匪浅。但当每个人都掌握了完善的信息时，交通拥堵就会蔓延到似乎可以绕开他们的小路上。

paragraphs.sourceText: This new congestion teaches us two things. The first is that the promises of technology will never be realised as fully as we hope; they will be limited by their unforeseen and unintended consequ,ences. Sitting in a more comfortable car in a different traffic jam is pleasant but hardly the liberation that once seemed to be promised. The second is that self-organisation will not get us where we want to go. The efforts of
paragraphs.translationZh: 这次新的拥堵告诉我们两件事。首先，技术的承诺永远不会像我们希望的那样完全实现；它们将受到不可预见和非预期后果的限制。在不同的交通拥堵中坐在更舒适的汽车里是令人愉快的，但很难想象曾经承诺的解放。第二，自组织不会让我们到达我们想去的地方。的努力

options.translationZh: 它是激活大脑最可靠的兴奋剂。

options.sourceText: It helps improve concentration and memory.
options.reflowSourceText: It helps improve concentration and memory.
options.translationZh: 它有助于提高注意力和记忆力。

options.sourceText: Sensitivity to cognitive stimulation.
options.reflowSourceText: Sensitivity to cognitive stimulation.
options.translationZh: 对认知刺激的敏感性。

options.sourceText: Subtlety of representation.
options.reflowSourceText: Subtlety of representation.
options.translationZh: 表现的微妙性。

options.sourceText: Accuracy in categorization.
options.reflowSourceText: Accuracy in categorization.
options.translationZh: 分类的准确性。

options.sourceText: Precision in visual perception.
options.reflowSourceText: Precision in visual perception.
options.translationZh: 视觉感知的精确性。

options.sourceText: They portray drivers who enjoy speed on the road.
options.reflowSourceText: They portray drivers who enjoy speed on the road.
options.translationZh: 他们描绘了享受道路上速度的司机。

options.sourceText: They present a false picture of the autonomy cars provide.
options.reflowSourceText: They present a false picture of the autonomy cars provide.
options.translationZh: 他们对汽车所提供的自动驾驶能力做出了错误的描述。

options.sourceText: They pursue individuality and originality in design concept.
options.reflowSourceText: They pursue individuality and originality in design concept.
options.translationZh: 他们在设计理念上追求个性、原创。

options.sourceText: They overestimate the potential market of autonomous cars.
options.reflowSourceText: They overestimate the potential market of autonomous cars.
options.translationZh: 他们高估了自动驾驶汽车的潜在市场。

options.sourceText: They can help to alleviate traffic jams.
options.reflowSourceText: They can help to alleviate traffic jams.
options.translationZh: 它们可以帮助缓解交通拥堵。

options.sourceText: Most of them are as effective as advertised.
options.reflowSourceText: Most of them are as effective as advertised.
options.translationZh: 其中大多数都像宣传的那样有效。

options.sourceText: Only some can be put to use under current traffic conditions.
options.reflowSourceText: Only some can be put to use under current traffic conditions.
options.translationZh: 在目前的交通状况下，只有部分可以投入使用。

options.sourceText: They are constantly upgraded to make driving easier and safer.
options.reflowSourceText: They are constantly upgraded to make driving easier and safer.
options.translationZh: 它们不断升级，使驾驶更轻松、更安全。

options.sourceText: It is likely to create traffic jams in other places.
options.reflowSourceText: It is likely to create traffic jams in other places.
options.translationZh: 很可能会造成其他地方的交通拥堵。

options.sourceText: It helps a great deal in easing traffic congestion.
options.reflowSourceText: It helps a great deal in easing traffic congestion.
options.translationZh: 对于缓解交通拥堵有很大帮助。

options.sourceText: It sharply reduces the incidence of traffic accidents.
options.reflowSourceText: It sharply reduces the incidence of traffic accidents.
options.translationZh: 大大降低了交通事故的发生率。

options.sourceText: It benefits those who are learning to drive.
options.reflowSourceText: It benefits those who are learning to drive.
options.translationZh: 它对那些学习驾驶的人有好处。

options.sourceText: Its consequences are usually difficult to assess.
options.reflowSourceText: Its consequences are usually difficult to assess.
options.translationZh: 其后果通常难以评估。

options.sourceText: It seldom delivers all the benefits as promised.
options.reflowSourceText: It seldom delivers all the benefits as promised.
options.translationZh: 它很少能兑现承诺的所有好处。

options.sourceText: It depends on the required knowledge for application.
options.reflowSourceText: It depends on the required knowledge for application.
options.translationZh: 这取决于应用所需的知识。

options.sourceText: Its benefits are guaranteed by collective wisdom.
options.reflowSourceText: Its benefits are guaranteed by collective wisdom.
options.translationZh: 它的好处是由集体智慧保证的。

options.sourceText: The consequences of technological innovation need not be exaggerated.
options.reflowSourceText: The consequences of technological innovation need not be exaggerated.
options.translationZh: 技术创新的后果无需夸大。

options.sourceText: There is always a price to pay to develop technology for a better world.
options.reflowSourceText: There is always a price to pay to develop technology for a better world.
options.translationZh: 为了更美好的世界而开发技术总是要付出代价的。

options.sourceText: Technological innovation should be properly regulated.
options.reflowSourceText: Technological innovation should be properly regulated.
options.translationZh: 科技创新要受到适当监管。

options.sourceText: The culture of Silicon Valley ought not to be emulated.
options.reflowSourceText: The culture of Silicon Valley ought not to be emulated.
options.translationZh: 硅谷的文化不应该被效仿。
